notes: Discovery reads .js files from <userDir>/workflows and from .harness/workflows at the workspace and each ancestor below home; a non-file, a visited real path, an oversize file and invalid meta are skipped.
Meta-only parsing lists a workflow whose body does not parse; an override is applied only when its full script parses, otherwise the earlier copy stays.

Project directories are iterated outermost first so the inner directory wins; user entries are applied before project entries; the catalog then merges bundled < plugin < user/project and sorts by localeCompare.
The per-workspace promise cache is keyed `${local}:${nameOnly}:${workspace}` and cleared by yXn, which also resets the plugin load memo.
workflow_run accepts name: scriptPath takes precedence, an explicit script overrides the named script, and a missing name reports `Workflow "name" not found. Available: ...`.
The account storage branch is bypassed because no storage argument is passed; the plugin and bundled providers are host inputs.
